description: This file defines a Fragment class for editing notes within an Android application. It provides UI logic for creating, updating, and deleting notes, utilizing ViewModel, ViewBinding, and LiveData flows.

classes.name: NoteEditorFragment
classes.description: Fragment responsible for editing and creating notes; manages UI interactions and communicates with ViewModel.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout and initializes view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the UI, loads existing note data if editing, and sets click listeners for Save and Delete actions.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Nullifies the view binding reference to avoid memory leaks.
